key_points.text: Summary: In this episode of the Special Situations Report, hosts Asif and Tamanna Suria discuss the latest developments in the event-driven investing world.

The episode continues by covering a range of M&A deals – including the Sanofi and Vigil Neuroscience deal with an attractive CVR and a twist on the typical thrift conversion playbook when it comes to NB Bancorp..
